import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    w = params[0]
    s = np.sin(w*t); c = np.cos(w*t)
    E = np.exp(-params[1]*t)
    return (params[2] + params[3]*s + params[4]*c
            + params[5]*x + params[6]*v
            + params[7]*x*s + params[8]*x*c + params[9]*v*s
            + 0*E)
